meta.name: Realm Item Overhaul
meta.notes: Redrawn 8x8 items. Sheet ix_items and this atlas_items.json are new files: they replace the item art in pack 1 (items sheet) and Expansion One (ex_items) without overwriting them. Sprite names match the old ones, so swapping is a lookup change. Potions and loot bags are unchanged and stay in the old sheets. 8 new legendary items drop from the Boss Overhaul's phase-3 forms. x5 frames carry a 1px outline (+1px padding per side).
